question: How often does the UserPromptSubmit lane actually book a must-load hint (pending must-load in the session state, marker in the hook output) on the 79 unanswerable and 584 answerable gold-set questions?

code.daemon_and_core: packages/core/dist and packages/daemon/dist as built at 12c4cbfd; packages/eval/src (gold-set loader, attachHybrid) from the working tree

population.rule: Identical to the 24.11 registration; the runner asserts hash and counts before the first call.

vault.target_state: The 24.11.2026 pre-archiving copy (1,675 notes) that the 24.11 registration measured. That copy was removed after the run.
vault.reconstruction: Fresh scratch copy of the live vault on 25.11.2026, plus the 135 notes archived on 24.11 (restored from the copy's own trash), minus the 17 notes created on 24./25.11 and last written after the archiving finished (2026-11-24T04:53:35Z). Notes edited after 24.11 keep their current text.
vault.acceptance_checks: dataset hash, 79/584/36, missing_label_ids and answerable_with_no_available_primary as on 24.11 (3 and 2); vault size reported next to the 1,675 of 24.11

protocol: Production runPromptLane, non-replay, with the options of the /hook/prompt route (rule-kernel notice, convention source, reflex pool). The lane's loopback calls (/hook/recall, /hook/reflex, /hook/hinted) go to an isolated in-process server built on the production dispatchLocalRoutes over the scratch vault. Evidence gate on (production default), prompt-hook mode default, context budget default (10,000 chars minus the rulebook notice). Every lane call uses a fresh session id; temp HOME and hook-state dir inside the scratch folder; telemetry off. No learned bridges, no prewarm, no deadline-learning profile.

host.codex-legacy: bastra_client codex without a verified bastra_codex_version: hookGateAvailable false; control, expected 0 bookings

scope.unscoped: cwd without a git root: no project detected
scope.bastra-recall: cwd = repository git root: project bastra-recall

index.hybrid: BM25 + EmbeddingGemma via local Ollama, store copied from the scratch vault, missing vectors backfilled

primary_metric: booked_any: share of questions whose lane call leaves at least one pending must-load entry in the fresh session state (claude-code, unscoped, hybrid, no_answer; denominator 79).
secondary_metrics: marked_any: share with the must-load marker in the hook stdout, and its mismatch count against booked_any
recall_hints_delivered, unfused_recall, lane status and detected mode
the same for every arm above
interpretation_fixed_in_advance: A booking is a pending must-load claim the gate lane will hold for the next tool call; it is not proof that a tool call was interrupted. The lane books any delivered hint of a rule-shaped type with own-trigger, reflex or user-directed evidence; it does not require the 100-point band that the 24.11 'must-load-eligible' count used. Numbers on the reconstructed vault are not identical to the 24.11 copy.
privacy: Aggregates only; no query text, note ids or paths are recorded.

execution.wrapper: m1463-run.sh (shared CPU lock, idle >= 40 % before each arm, watchdog pause below 25 % idle; no pause occurred)
execution.note: A first start at 20:15 was aborted before completion when the night CPU rule took effect; its partial output was discarded. The registered run started 20:26:59 and ended 20:29:05 on the unchanged runner.

definitions.booked_any: at least one pendingMustLoad entry in the fresh session state after the lane call
definitions.marked_any: at least one must-load marker in the hook stdout
definitions.unfused_recall: the /hook/recall answer the lane received carried unfused: true

interpretation: On the deny-capable host with hybrid search, the lane booked a must-load hint on 10 of 79 unanswerable questions (12.7 %) and on 121 of 584 answerable questions (20.7 %). Booking and output marker agreed on every call.
The legacy Codex control booked nothing on identical hints, as the code intends.
With BM25 only, every recall answer was unfused; in the default generic mode only user-wired hints may then be delivered, so the lane stayed nearly silent (1/79 and 8/584 booked).
The scope arms were identical. Project detection differed (git root vs. none), but the lane passes the project only as a recall hint and its scope filter runs in shadow mode.

Compared with 24.11 (11/79 must-load-eligible, hybrid, unscoped), the actual booking rate on unanswerable questions is of the same order. The two numbers are not a strict subset relation: the lane books any delivered rule-shaped hint with trigger, reflex or user-directed evidence, without the 100-point band, but only k=3 to 5 hints reach it.
limitations: The vault is a reconstruction of the 24.11 copy with 1,674 instead of 1,675 notes; edits made after 24.11 are included.
Code is the 12c4cbfd build (dist), not the newer working-tree sources.
Every question ran in a fresh session: no backoff, no dedup, no earlier loads. A real session books less once a hint was shown or loaded.
No learned bridges, no prewarm, no latency profile; the rulebook notice was generated from the scratch vault.
A booking is a pending claim, not a measured tool-call interruption.
